theorems.name: Submission.lip_approx_hole_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∃ ε δ₀ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < δ₀ ∧ 0 < C₀ ∧ ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ ρ : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₀ → V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ → ∀ (T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)) (F : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsClosed F → (∀ x ∈ F, ∀ z ∈ F, ‖(x - z) - T.starProjection (x - z)‖ ≤ ε * ‖x - z‖) → ∀ ζ ∈ F, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 17 * (δ * ρ) / 32 → 0 < infDist ζ V.support → infDist ζ V.support ≤ δ * ρ / 16 → ENNReal.ofReal ((infDist ζ V.support / 2) ^ n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C₀ * (V.weight (closedBall ζ (3 * (infDist ζ V.support / 2)) \ F) + ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * (infDist ζ V.support / 2)), hsNormSq (V.tangentProj x - T.starProjection) ∂V.weight))
